name: GPS units (car and handheld)

comps.spec: Standalone GPS receiver with maps on board — no phone, signal or internet needed; handhelds run on AA cells
comps.loc: The whole unit: check gloveboxes and drawers

comps.spec: 3.7V lithium pouch, about 800–1,500 mAh (car units) — old ones are often swollen
Ceramic patch antenna; some have a socket for an external antenna
12–24V to 5V converter in the car power lead or mount
microSD card or internal flash holding the maps

notes: Roads rarely move: an old car sat nav still routes well. Lift the unit off its suction mount and take the 12V lead with it.

sources.title: Open Repair Alliance, Open Repair Data v0.3 (community repair events, 2012 to July 2026; CC BY-SA 4.0): 413 repairs recorded as Sat-nav / GPS (subset of Tablet and others)
